task.title: Harden the owned-definition guard test in hosted.rs
task.description: Filed from the P6-039 adversarial review (2026-08-09). The structural guard test (owned_definition_guard in app/src/backend/hosted.rs) asserts the inline owned-per-oracle aggregation never reappears, but the substring needle is (a) bypassable — a re-derived aggregate with different aliases, reversed join order, a comma-join, or GROUP BY 1 sails past it — and (b) able to false-fail — the needle has no terminator, so a legitimate future per-board breakdown (GROUP BY p.oracle_id, h.board) would trip it. Harden the matcher to catch re-derivations by structure rather than exact spelling (e.g. token-normalize the SQL before matching) without tripping on collection- or board-scoped aggregations, which are legitimate different computations. Optional tidy while there: collection_tree's d.desired_total is an uncast sum(quantity) while shopping_list casts ::int — harmless asymmetry the review noted. Specs: specs/collection-api.md.
